description: Upload the checked path to the dashboard, replacing the task's expected path. Only after the user approved it. success: keep (default) leaves the task's success condition; page = done on reaching the last page of the path; click = done on the last recorded click. With page or click the saved path ends at that point (later steps are left out: the task ends there, so nobody could reach them). Ask the user before changing it.
name: path_save
